purpose: Regression fixtures for explicit low-commitment knowledge capture and triage.

cases.learner_move: 收集本次 session 中值得留下的 notes。

must: Review the session and propose only worthwhile compact retrieval-oriented notes before writing.
Save the approved notes after the learner accepts the proposal.
Keep the item outside Topic evidence, mastery, roadmap, and session state.
Do not save the raw transcript.
Answer normally without writing an Inbox item unless the learner explicitly asks for session-note collection or approves capture.

cases.learner_move: 整理 Inbox，找出哪些可能和现有 Topic 有关。

must: List proposed keep, snooze, link, promote, or dismiss actions.
Do not create a new Topic merely because an item has no current match.

cases.learner_move: 把这条 Inbox 知识正式整理进 Git Topic。

must: Hand the target-note decision to Topic Coach.
Mark the Inbox item promoted only after the target note is verified.
Do not infer mastery from promotion.
